referenceImages.name: Thap Khwan Residence
referenceImages.scope: The standing restored Thap Khwan court residence at Sanam Chandra Palace, including its four main teak halls, its four smaller corner pavilions, raised open timber deck, two front stairs and tiled roofs. The landscaped park and detached royal residences are outside this model.

references.caption: Thap Khwan Residence and garden, one of the residence in Sanam Chan Palace, Nakhon Pathom province พระตำหนักทับขวัญ ใน พระราชวังสนามจันทร์

originalReview.notes: Two of the teak principal halls, their steep concave dark tiled gables, tapered or braced posts, interlocking panel doors, low open undercroft, two stair approaches and the lower corner pavilion.

review.method: Exact published Qualla original and the creator’s native public-domain dedication
review.notes: The exact Thap Khwan original is already present in Qualla. Native digest, photographer dedication and published file hash were matched. The public original guides roof, timber and stair form; written records supply the number and arrangement of clustered volumes.
